plan: Since this is a single-round auction and my value is $28, I want to bid high enough to win against likely bids, but not so high that I overpay. Given the possible values range from $0 to $20, it's reasonable to assume other bidders won't bid significantly above $20. I will bid slightly above $20 to increase my chances of winning without risking a large payment.

I'll bid slightly above the midpoint of my value and a conservative estimate of others' values to increase my chances of winning without excessive payment.
